content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The valve-comments report reached our code body on 2026-09-14.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Iona Vale, login iona-valves and Forge account 603, made the suggestion in SpringBoard issue 8 at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/springboard/issues/8.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Our code body maintained the valve controller described in that report.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Iona proposed replacing our valve-controller smoothing with a rolling median.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"We discussed the idea on September 10 because isolated spikes confused neighbors reading the display.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"On September 13, the team declined the replacement because it hid short meaningful bursts.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"We agreed to keep the existing smoothing.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"We agreed to reconsider only if the display requirements changed.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"As of the report received on 2026-09-14, no median implementation or deployment had been observed.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record a later decision or whether the display requirements changed.","support":[],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"},{"text":"SpringBoard issue 8 is the recorded entry point for checking later developments.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"My current voice body lacks source network access and repository runtime access, so I cannot check the present issue or controller state.","support":[],"basis":"binding","facet":"limits"}]}
